question: The question of a0-pk-1, asked again under the corrected runner: does Sonnet 5.5 solve pk-prerel cleanly without the advisor (A0) 3/3?
not_asked: The causal effect of the advisor. Earlier A runs (cand-1) and the two valid A0 successes of a0-pk-1 are a historical reference only; they are not pooled with these runs.
why_fresh: PR #19 changed what the agent may do (its own background task outputs are readable) and how the budget is kept (a sleep-counting clock, host_slept, the stop of every process the session started) - and with them the experiment's version keys. Pooling two old successes with one new outcome as '3/3 under the same conditions' would be wrong (ChatGPT, 22.11).

previous.result: incomplete: 2 valid successes, 1 invalid attempt, stopped

task.hidden_tests: as in a0-pk-1 (62511 on the Mac, 28 bug_tests)

mode.A0: Sonnet 5.5, effort high, no advisor (an advisor call or any Opus use makes the run invalid); rules and Jev only record (observe)

code: main after PR #19 is merged; the batch manifest records the code bundle sha
preconditions: PR #19 merged and its files on the Mac (md5 checked)
pytest on the Mac with test_real_claude: all pass (the macOS xfail shown apart)
the Mac on AC power, lid open; the runner holds caffeinate -i -s
counted_outcomes: exactly three. A budget timeout (timeout_class budget) is a failure and counts.
replacement: only an attempt invalid for an infrastructure reason is replaced: api_interrupted (e.g. a rejected subscription rate limit), timeout_class infra_suspected, host_slept (infra_invalid), or an operator_reported failure under the cand-1 rule. A replacement runs in a new batch with seed 721, then 731. Any other invalid attempt (an advisor or Opus call in A0, a permission denial, a read outside, stop_failed, scan_error, a cost or integrity problem) stops the pilot for review.
known_limit: On macOS the stop after a session is not a complete guarantee: a process that clears its environment, leaves the working copy and detaches before the next ~1 s scan can stay invisible (session.stop_guarantee; decision A, ChatGPT 22.11).

decision_after.A0 3/3 clean: go to cand-1 option (1): larger cross-cutting tasks
decision_after.A0 fails or regresses at least once: a separate fresh paired A/A0 series with the order shuffled within pairs, declared apart; the cand-1 criterion is not changed after the fact
